d: Lounge in the residence of Egberto. Large window in the middle of which you will see the battlements of the castle. Sonvi side doors, table with writing objects, chairs, etc...The room is empty. Inside singing from the right indicates the end of a banquet. Chorus.
Thrilled Mina, from the right.
Detta, Aroldo and Briano from the right.
Aroldo and Mina.
Said and Briano from the left.
Mina, so Egberto looks from the left.

Escape of halls lit at great feast. In the first furniture of the time, over one of which is a book closed by clasp with key. Dame, Knights, meet and head to different parts. For a moment you will see them only in the bottom; then Godvino and Briano.
Sayings. Henry dressed like Godvino, then Aroldo, Mina to the arm of Egberto, Elena, Scudieri, Paggi, etc.

Ancient cemetery of the castle of Kenth. In the center is a cross with steps; on the right the door of a temple internally illuminated, to which you ascend for grandiose stairs: on the left at the bottom you see the castle. The moon frivolously illuminates the scattered graves here and there shaded by centuries-old cypresses. One of those is recent. Mina from the bottom to the left very agitated.
Detta and Godvino.
Said and Egberto, who comes from the bottom to the left, closed in his cloak. He has two swords.
Egberto and Godvino.
Said and Aroldo from the temple.
Said and Mina from the bottom to the left.
Said and Briano from the temple.
Room in the residence of Egberto that puts at various apartments. Above a table is the necessities to write. Egberto enters thoughtfully to read a writing.
That said, then Briano abstracted from the right.
Egberto alone.
Aroldo from the left, then Godvino from the right.
Aroldo and Mina from the right.
Say. Egberto from the left with bloody sword to the hand; Briano from the right.
Aroldo, Mina and Briano.

Deep valley in Scotland. The shore of Lake Loomond can be seen in perspective. Practicable mountains, covered with woods to the right and left, where is a pine forest near which a modest house. The sun falls. Far away sounds of bagpipes and horns lean. Voices of Shepherds, Women and Hunters, who descend from the mountains and meet on the scene.
Briano and Aroldo in the same costume of solitaires appear from a summit to the right; and they go down to the house.

It is night; the moon that has risen during the prayer is covered by big clouds; the impetuous wind blows and upsets the lake. Montanari and Women from various parts, then Egberto, Mina, and two Barcaiuoli.
Egberto and Mina.
Said and Aroldo.
Said and Briano from the house.
